limits: Exports are public sample scenes of the full selected setup, not screenshots of private applied content or a projection of Apply-domain checkboxes. Clock/Weather use shared native components; other cards/applets are native illustrations.
Only compiled public backgrounds and colors/gradients are rendered. Personal/unlisted pictures are omitted. Existing setup JSON export remains separate.
The native portal is not driven here. Native action clicks, cancellation/source fencing, export request/filter plumbing, owned renderer and confined atomic file writes are checked separately.

Actual stock vertical panel is qualified with one real native Clock applet in private COSMIC. Vertical Islands, arbitrary applet layouts, physical output/GPU transitions and exact package acceptance remain separate.
No installs, uploads, commits, publication or version bump.
